title: fix(metadata)!: unregisterPackage keeps the rows that name the package by the _packageId stamp alone; detector for 17.0.0–18.3.0 stamped environment rows (#32985)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Refs #32985

The card stays open (seat ruling 2026-11-14T19:48Z): the follow-up PR keeps column-bound rows an 18.4.0 boot bound unless history shows them stamped since create (kept on undetermined or with no history table), and notes that a future uninstall UI must use `unregisterPackageWithReport` and surface `kept` (`IMetadataService.unregisterPackage` has no force or result).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: `unregisterPackage(P)` keeps, until `{ force: true }`, items it used to remove (every item stored in a row with an empty `package_id` whose body names P by `_packageId` alone, including every `DatabaseLoader`-stored `object`/`view`/`app`/`page` of P); the boot bind and `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` leave such rows unbound. Widened: additive in-process surface (`unregisterPackageWithReport`, `{ force }`, `MetadataLoader.stampOnlyRows`, `detectStampOnlyRows`, the `'stamp-only'` left reason).
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** (review#3 M1, 6883260484): a caller of `MetadataManager.unregisterPackage` over a `DatabaseLoader` now keeps and reports items whose stored rows name the package by the `_packageId` stamp alone, every `object`/`view`/`app`/`page` item of the package among them. Run `detectStampOnlyRows`, then pass `{ force: true }` (or use `unregisterPackageWithReport`) to remove the package's own items as before. The changeset carries the adr-0087 not-required (no-migration-prescription) marker. The any-source guard (wider than the ruling's `source='database'`) was accepted by review because it only errs toward keeping.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`unregisterPackage` 遇到「`package_id` 列为空、正文只靠 `_packageId` 印记指向该包」的存储行时,默认保留该条目并报告(`{ force: true }` 才删);启动时的列绑定与运维迁移不再凭这种印记绑定 `package_id`;新增只读检测器 `detectStampOnlyRows`,按每行自己的历史判定印记来源;changeset 附升级说明。
- **为什么改**:17.0.0–18.3.0 在「声明 packageId 的 MetadataPlugin + eager 无 artifactSource + DatabaseLoader」组合下,把宿主印记写进了环境自有的行;main 上卸载宿主包会把这些环境数据连行删掉(18.3.0 实建库 37 行删 34 行),属静默数据丢失红线。
- **风险与回滚**:代价是误保留——非按包存储的类型(object/view/app…)的包自有行同样只有印记,卸载时会被保留并 warn,需 `force`;无数据迁移、无新写入,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `unregisterPackageWithReport`(先全量检查、后删除);`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` 的 `bindReadRowPackage` 新跳过与 `stampOnlyRows`;`packages/metadata/src/migrations/detect-stamp-only-rows.ts` 的历史链判定。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32985`,预期所有 #32985 用例通过(18.3.0 形态的行全部保留、`force` 后删除)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The binding ruling is the maintainer decision of 2026-11-14 on #32985 (guard + detector + upgrade note; no ownership-changing migration now), as the seat recorded it on the card. Every `@objectstack/metadata` from 17.0.0 through 18.3.0, on a host whose `MetadataPlugin` declares its `packageId`, primed eagerly with no `artifactSource`, with a `DatabaseLoader`, saved each package-less row its boot pass read back stamped with the host (`_packageId`, `_provenance`). From the row alone such an environment row cannot be told from a row of the host's own item; the #32986 mark does not reach it, because its stored body already names the host.

**1. The guard (red line).** `unregisterPackage(P)` (and the new `unregisterPackageWithReport(P)`) keeps an item, registry entry and rows, when any loader holds a row of it whose `package_id` column is empty and whose stored body names P by `_packageId` alone, neither `packageId` nor the legacy `package` naming any package (`stampOnlyPackageOf`, new `src/stamp-only-row.ts`; `DatabaseLoader.stampOnlyRows`, new optional `MetadataLoader.stampOnlyRows`). Every row is checked before the first removal, so a failed read throws and removes nothing. Each kept item is reported in the result (`kept`, `reason: 'stamp-only-row'`, each row's loader, id and `source`) and in one `warn` naming the detector and `{ force: true }`; `force` removes them as before. The check reads storage at removal time rather than marking registry objects, so no copy a later writer registers can drop it (the hole #33003 had to close for the #32986 mark).

- **Deliberately wider than the ruling's `source = 'database'`:** the check takes every writer's row. Measured on the 18.3.0-built fixture, the boot also stamped another writer's package-less row (`agent/api_agent`, `source = 'api'`), and `main` deleted it on `unregisterPackage(host)`. Under 64ce235's reading a body stamp in such a row binds nothing (it is the environment's for every column reader), so keeping it only ever keeps an environment row.
- **`unregisterPackageWithReport` is a method of its own** because the spec's `IMetadataService.unregisterPackage` answers void and a class method cannot answer more under that signature; the published contract is not widened here.

**2. `bindReadRowPackage` (the boot's column-only bind): it can skip stamp-only rows, and does.** FROM binding the empty `package_id` column of a legacy row whose body names its package by `_packageId` alone TO leaving it. Pinned both ways: such a row (the host's stamp, or another package's) is not bound and nothing is written; a legacy row naming its package by its own `packageId` is still bound; and the cost to a genuine pre-#32246 legacy row is pinned by a CONTROL — a row the host's file item seeded is bound on the same boot by that item's own save (the save path's column-only binding, unchanged). What is left unbound is a legacy row no shipped code rewrites; reads of it are unchanged (the loader reads its package off the body).

**3. `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages`** leaves the same rows, new reason `'stamp-only'`.

**4. Read-only detector:** `detectStampOnlyRows(store, { packageId? })` in `@objectstack/metadata/migrations`, next to the migration it pairs with and in the shape of the read-only `scrubHistoryDrainedKeys` count — chosen over an `os migrate meta --stored`-style CLI because it is the smallest thing an operator can run against a driver today, touches no package outside `@objectstack/metadata`, and a CLI can wrap it later. It takes `find` only and reports every row whose body names a package by `_packageId` alone with its column empty or naming that package (an 18.4.0 boot bound by-package rows to the host), each with a verdict from its own history, walked back from the row's `checksum` through `previous_checksum` (so another holder's history of the name is never read as its own): `stamp-added` (a version naming no package, then one adding the stamp; `onlyStampAdded` marks the boot's signature), `stamped-since-create`, or `undetermined`.

**5. Upgrade note** in the changeset: affected releases 17.0.0–18.3.0, the composition, the symptoms (rows read as host-owned, phantom 409 holders, deletion on uninstall before this change, the 18.4.0 column bind), the detector, and the manual recipe for a `stamp-added` row. It makes no claim about first-party reach (the cloud product's `MetadataPlugin` configuration is owed a separate check).

**6. Fold-in (review nit N1 of merged PR #33299):** `keyedEntryBodies`'s doc comment now says the order handed on is the keyed entries first, then the unkeyed bodies, FROM `loadMany`'s row order. Text only.

| Door | FROM | TO |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `unregisterPackage(P)` over an item a loader stores in a row with an empty `package_id` whose body names P by `_packageId` alone, any `source` | item and rows removed | kept and reported (result `kept`, one `warn`); nothing removed if a check fails |
| `unregisterPackage(P, { force: true })` | — | removes them too, as before |
| `unregisterPackage(P)` over an item whose body names P by its own `packageId` / `package`, or whose column is bound | removed | removed (unchanged) |
| boot column-only bind of a legacy row named by `_packageId` alone | bound to that package | left empty; a row whose package's code still ships is bound by that item's own save |
| `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` over such a row | bound | left `'stamp-only'` |

## Tests

- New top-level `describe('[#32985] …')` in `database-loader.test.ts` (rows seeded as 18.3.0 left them, by-package and other types): the boot binds no column and writes nothing; `unregisterPackageWithReport(host)` keeps every item and row and reports each, one `warn`; another writer's stamped row kept the same; the contract door answers nothing and keeps them, `force` removes them; CONTROL rows naming the host by their own `packageId` removed without `force`; CONTROL another package's removal moves nothing; a failing check throws before any removal.
- R7-A pins: the stamp-only legacy agent row (host's stamp, another package's stamp) is not bound; the bind mechanics re-pinned on a row naming its package by its own `packageId`; the file-seeded legacy row CONTROL above.
- `detect-stamp-only-rows.test.ts` (new, 8 cases): each verdict, the 18.4.0-bound column, `onlyStampAdded` false, an unprovisioned history table (`unavailable`) vs any other read failure (thrown), the per-row checksum chain beside another holder's history, the rows never reported, `packageId` narrowing, and `find`-only access.
- Fixture triage of pins this moves, each re-judged rather than re-spelled in bulk:
  - **Re-spelled** (they pin binding mechanics, not the stamp): `bind-database-loader-row-packages.test.ts` fixtures `_packageId: A` to `packageId: A` (26 lines), and the two C3 `bindReadRowPackage` cases in `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`; the migration's first case now also pins `stamp-only` for a flat and a wrapped stamp-only body and binding for a stamp beside the item's own `packageId`.
  - **Flipped** (they pinned exactly the removed behaviour): the #32986 CONTROL "the host's own rows (stamp alone) are still removed" is now kept-and-reported, then removed with `force`; the #32198 CONTROL for a type outside the set (a `_packageId`-only item's row, which `DatabaseLoader` never column-binds) is now kept-and-reported, then removed with `force`.
  - **Forced** (they pin what the #32986/#33003 mark alone keeps, which `force` does not lift): the #33003 CONTROLs whose host rows carry the stamp alone (database-loader.test.ts, six writers plus three single cases) and the objectql late-bridge CONTROL (`plugin-late-bridge-environment-row.test.ts`); the #32353 door-removal CONTROL.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rows an 18.4.0 boot already bound are outside the guard.** 18.4.0 (published 2026-11-13) bound the `package_id` column of each stamped by-package row to the host at first boot. Such a row now names the host by its column, so the ruling's criterion (no package column) does not hold and `unregisterPackage(host)` still removes it. The detector reports it (`column` set, verdict from history). Whether the deletion door should also consult history for column-bound rows is a decision, raised in the report, not taken here.
- **The guard is deletion-only.** On the replayed fixture the symptoms the upgrade note names still read the same: a stamped row is listed as the host's, and a bare read of `action/helper` is still refused `409 ambiguous-in-environment` naming the host as a holder, until the row is repaired by hand (recipe in the changeset).
- **False positives are wide for one class:** `DatabaseLoader` writes no column for a type not stored per `(package, name)`, so every row it stores for a package's item of such a type names the package by the stamp alone and is now kept until `force`. `unregisterPackage` has no first-party production caller (its CHANGELOG records 0).
- The detector does not report a row whose column names another package while its body stamp names the host (`flow/pkg_flow` in the fixture): the column owns it.
- `MetadataManager.register` of a by-package item read from a stamp-only row still binds that row's column through the save path's column-only binding when it writes the row (unchanged; the boot no longer does).
